name: Echoing Soul

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Two skills, a language and an Expertise you can move each Long Rest; a natural 1 can leave you dazed and slow.

benefits.name: Echoes of Other Lives
benefits.summary: Proficiency in two skills and one extra language.
benefits.text: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice and learn one language of your choice.

benefits.name: Borrowed Mastery
benefits.summary: Expertise in one skill you're proficient in; you can change it when you finish a Long Rest.
benefits.text: Choose one skill in which you have proficiency; you have Expertise in it. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can choose a different skill instead.

drawback.name: Drawback
drawback.summary: On a natural 1: Wisdom save (DC 13 + PB) or Incapacitated with half Speed until the end of your next turn.
drawback.text: Whenever you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus); on a failure the other souls in you surface: you have the Incapacitated condition and your Speed is halved until the end of your next turn.
